impact_assessment.why: The village skyline is static and has no landmark; a windmill adds a recognizable destination, a world feature and continuous animation.
impact_assessment.benefits: A rotating windmill visible from the spawn, a stronger skyline, eight baked blade frames shared by the pixel and GPU builds, and a warm window light at night.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one new world entity on the deterministic layout; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; growth: eight poses of roughly 130 faces; placement must stay dry, walkable, off the path and outside the quest route.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Place it via _walkable_near at village (-24,-18), keep the solid radius at 3m, assert both generated worlds contain it at the same coordinates, cap the pose set at eight, and verify the spawn and pixel-village captures.
